user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Deploy Java application as a systemd service
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    app_name: myapp
    service_description: "My Java Application Service"
    app_user: myapp
    app_group: myapp
    app_home: "/opt/{{ app_name }}"
    data_dir: "/var/lib/{{ app_name }}"
    log_dir: "/var/log/{{ app_name }}"
    jar_name: "{{ app_name }}.jar"
    jar_source: "./{{ jar_name }}"  # Path on the control node
    java_opts: "-Xms512m -Xmx512m -XX:+UseG1GC"
    app_opts: ""
    env_file: "{{ (ansible_facts.os_family == 'Debian') | ternary('/etc/default/' + app_name, '/etc/sysconfig/' + app_name) }}"
    nologin_shell: "{{ (ansible_facts.os_family == 'Debian') | ternary('/usr/sbin/nologin', '/sbin/nologin') }}"
    java_pkg: "{{ (ansible_facts.os_family == 'Debian') | ternary('openjdk-21-jre-headless', 'java-21-openjdk-headless') }}"

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure apt cache is up to date (Debian/Ubuntu)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == 'Debian'

    - name: Install OpenJDK 21 and CA certificates
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name:
          - "{{ java_pkg }}"
          - ca-certificates
        state: present

    - name: Ensure application group exists
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ app_group }}"
        system: true

    - name: Ensure application user exists
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ app_user }}"
        comment: "Service account for {{ app_name }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: "{{ nologin_shell }}"
        home: "/nonexistent"
        create_home: false

    - name: Create application directories
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ item.owner }}"
        group: "{{ item.group }}"
        mode: "{{ item.mode }}"
      loop:
        - { path: "{{ app_home }}", owner: "root", group: "root", mode: "0755" }
        - { path: "{{ data_dir }}", owner: "{{ app_user }}", group: "{{ app_group }}", mode: "0750" }
        - { path: "{{ log_dir }}", owner: "{{ app_user }}", group: "{{ app_group }}", mode: "0750" }

    - name: Copy application JAR
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ jar_source }}"
        dest: "{{ app_home }}/{{ jar_name }}"
        owner: "root"
        group: "root"
        mode: "0644"
      notify:
        - restart {{ app_name }}

    - name: Write environment file
      ansible.builtin.blockinfile:
        path: "{{ env_file }}"
        create: true
        owner: "root"
        group: "root"
        mode: "0644"
        marker: "# {mark} Ansible managed block for {{ app_name }}"
        block: |
          # Environment configuration for {{ app_name }}
          JAVA_OPTS="{{ java_opts }}"
          APP_OPTS="{{ app_opts }}"
          # Example extra variables:
          # PORT=8080
      notify:
        - restart {{ app_name }}

    - name: Write systemd unit file
      ansible.builtin.blockinfile:
        path: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ app_name }}.service"
        create: true
        owner: "root"
        group: "root"
        mode: "0644"
        marker: "# {mark} Ansible managed unit for {{ app_name }}"
        block: |
          [Unit]
          Description={{ service_description }}
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ app_user }}
          Group={{ app_group }}
          WorkingDirectory={{ data_dir }}
          EnvironmentFile=-{{ env_file }}
          ExecStart=/usr/bin/java $JAVA_OPTS -jar {{ app_home }}/{{ jar_name }} $APP_OPTS
          SuccessExitStatus=143
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5s
          TimeoutStopSec=30s
          UMask=0027
          LimitNOFILE=65536
          StandardOutput=journal
          StandardError=journal

          # Runtime directory under /run
          RuntimeDirectory={{ app_name }}
          RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750

          # Security hardening
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          PrivateDevices=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectHome=read-only
          ReadWritePaths={{ data_dir }} {{ log_dir }}
          ProtectKernelTunables=true
          ProtectKernelModules=true
          ProtectControlGroups=true
          RestrictSUIDSGID=true
          LockPersonality=true
          RemoveIPC=true
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          AmbientCapabilities=

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      notify:
        - systemd daemon-reload
        - restart {{ app_name }}

    - name: Ensure service is enabled and started
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ app_name }}"
        state: started
        enabled: true

  handlers:
    - name: systemd daemon-reload
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: restart {{ app_name }}
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ app_name }}"
        state: restarted
        enabled: true
